definition: Implementation Profile of the operation Topographic position index, whose meaning is its activity type (activityType): the signature of the Generic Profile Terrain derivative, bound to data exchange formats.

hasAction.description: The meaning of the operation moves to the activity type https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/topographic-position-index, linked by activityType (gp:activityType). The definition no longer defines the operation; it was: "The topographic position index (TPI) of Guisan et al. (1999): the difference between the elevation of each cell and the mean elevation of its neighbourhood."
The source defining the operation moves to the activity type: Guisan, A., Weiss, S.B., Weiss, A.D. (1999): GLM versus CCA spatial modeling of plant species distribution. Plant Ecology 143: 107-122.

The schema copied on each input and output that had one is replaced by the representation that realizes its data type in the data-formats register (decision D6): inputs/elevation -> elevation-model-geotiff (schema was {"type": "string", "contentEncoding": "base64", "contentMediaType": "image/tiff", "description": "GeoTIFF"}); outputs/result -> raster-single-band-geotiff (schema was {"type": "string", "contentEncoding": "base64", "contentMediaType": "image/tiff", "description": "GeoTIFF"}).

Decision D4: tool keywords removed: ta_morphometry; 2 format keywords removed from inputs and outputs (inputs/elevation: GeoTIFF; outputs/result: GeoTIFF); sources removed (tools, testbed, the bbox schema now in the representation's format): SAGA 7.3.0 -- Topographic Position Index (TPI) <https://saga-gis.sourceforge.io/saga_tool_doc/7.3.0/ta_morphometry_18.html>; ZOO-Project Geonovum testbed -- SAGA.ta_morphometry.18: Topographic Position Index (TPI) <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.ta_morphometry.18>; description rewritten without tool, host or testbed. Each removed tool or testbed reference remains findable at tier 4, in bblocks-process-profiles.

Corrects what https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/topographic-position-index/actions/tools-2026-11-09 describes: the description sections removed then (sources, illustrations, data formats, multiplicity and the open question where present, and the Register position reference to the tier-4 process and its testbed URL) are restored. Tools and testbed stay in the prose; decision D4 applies to the model (keywords, source, properties), which carries none. Decision of 2026-11-09.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/topographic-position-index to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/topographic-position-index, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/topographic-position-index/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
